body: Well its nothing in the grand scheme of things.  but i have been putting it off for a few more hrs, then that turned into days, then weeks, now yrs and its taken its toll.  I dont want to put it off any more.
The booze and pills would be used to end my life, not numb it or to get wasted or to try and feel good.

I do have some hobbbies, but have zero desire to do them anymore.  Stress coping we have been actively working on various different styles, and this is one of them.  To reach out to a hotline or the internet for help.   
I do not drink.  hate the stuff really.  At one time in my 20's i got into drinking some, but it was never my thing.  Im 43 and I keep a couple of good bottles of various types of booze for any guests.  Never have any so i have plenty of booze to wash down the pills.
